# The Dog Outdoors

> The Dog Outdoors is your headquarters for premium active dog gear and apparel, offering durable outdoor equipment from trusted brands like Ruffwear and EzyDog since 2007.

The Dog Outdoors specializes in high-quality dog gear designed for outdoor adventures, including winter coats, harnesses, life vests, and cooling gear. The site features seasonal collections, discounted items, and USA-made products across multiple categories.
